versions.changelog: Disclose all background probes and local state writes, replace executable config.env sourcing with allowlisted parsing, and correct restart-related documentation.
Align documentation with the read-only implementation and declare current OpenClaw requirements plus optional Discord egress variables.
Added simplified installation instructions to SKILL.md and README.md.
Rename display name to Gateway Watchdog Discord for shorter ClawHub listing.
Initial public release: Discord-first gateway watchdog with cron + launchd fallback, dedupe/cooldown, and sanitized config placeholders.
